summary: Editing aap_operator_service_account removes its is_superuser flag and breaks reconciliation with "Create operator service account user ... That username is already taken"; delete the user and the operator recreates it as a superuser.
questions: Error: That username is already taken when creating operator service account user
Platform gateway operator reconciliation fails after editing a user

answer_card.title: Operator service account error
answer_card.answer_md: Error: `Create operator service account user ... That username is already taken`. Cause: `aap_operator_service_account` was edited and lost `is_superuser`. Fix: delete that user; the operator recreates it with `is_superuser=True`.
